lead: I’m Gromit Forger, a graphic design senior at SCAD. I don’t say much, so I make sure the work does.

blocks.body:
I’m applying for a junior designer role on a team that takes ideas and craft equally seriously. Over four years at SCAD I have designed posters, books, identities, information graphics, and short films, and I’m ready for whatever the team needs next.

Most of my work starts with language. I look for the moment when form says something the words alone can’t, and I keep a record of how I got there. That is why every project on this site shows the process as well as the result.

blocks.heading: What I bring
blocks.body: I notice problems early and fix them before anyone has to ask. Three summers of four o’clock starts at a bakery taught me to keep standards high when the deadline is close and the ovens are hot. I take direction well, I ask good questions, and I finish what I start.

blocks.heading: What I’m looking for
blocks.body: A studio or an in-house team, ideally on editorial, cultural, or brand work. I graduate in June 2027 and can relocate to New York or Chicago.

blocks.heading: Outside the studio
blocks.body: I run a lettering club, build model railways, and walk Bond, our family dog, who always seems to know where we’re going before I do.
